title: Pulling Hⁿ-a.e. properties of M ∩ Φ(Ω) back to Lⁿ-a.e. parameters of an antilipschitz chart
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let M ⊆ ℝ^P be Hⁿ-null-measurable (Hⁿ = μHE[n]), let Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ be (Borel) measurable, and let Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P be (Borel) measurable with c|w − w′| ≤ |Φ(w) − Φ(w′)| for all w, w′ ∈ Ω, for some c > 0. Let p be any property of points of ℝ^P that holds at Hⁿ-a.e. point of M ∩ Φ(Ω) (∀ᵐ x for Hⁿ⌞(M ∩ Φ(Ω))). Then Ω ∩ Φ⁻¹(M) is Lⁿ-null-measurable (Lⁿ = volume), and p(Φ(w)) holds for Lⁿ-a.e. w ∈ Ω ∩ Φ⁻¹(M) (∀ᵐ w for Lⁿ⌞(Ω ∩ Φ⁻¹(M))).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (p : Eucl P → Prop), MeasurableSet Ω → Measurable Φ → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (M ∩ Φ '' Ω)), p x) → NullMeasurableSet (Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' M) (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) ∧ ∀ᵐ w ∂((volume : Measure (Eucl n)).restrict (Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' M)), p (Φ w)
